name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible failure in setup, authoring, playback or export

What did you ask the kit to do?

What happened, and what should have happened?

Which command, host/OS and kit version were used? Include the exact error and a minimal synthetic project if possible.

Keep private source material, credentials and machine-specific personal data out of the report. See SECURITY.md for sensitive reports.
